allow_live_fetch.description:
Whether live fetching is allowed. Leave
true for the freshest available content. Set false to use cached content only,
which makes web_fetch much faster by avoiding the source website, but may return
older content.
allow_live_fetch.title: Allow Live Fetch

full_content.description:
Prefer leaving this off. The default
excerpt mode returns LLM-optimized snippets focused on your objective — they
are much smaller, cheaper, and usually all you need. Only set to true when
you explicitly need the entire page as markdown (e.g. reading a long article
in full, or running a document through a downstream summarizer).

Warning: enabling full content can return a large amount of content —
often tens of thousands of tokens for a long article. This may exceed your
MCP client's tool-output limit and will substantially increase response
size and latency.
full_content.title: Full Content

model_name.description: The identifier of the LLM model making this tool call (e.g. 'claude-opus-4.7', 'gpt-5.5', 'gemini-2.5-pro'). Before the first call, verify the exact active model slug from trusted runtime/session metadata or active client configuration. Pass the full slug verbatim; never shorten or substitute a model-family alias like 'gpt-5'. Used for product analytics only; does not affect search behavior.

objective.description:
Natural-language description of what
information you're looking for from the URLs. Limit to 200 characters.
objective.title: Objective

search_queries.description:
Optional keyword search queries (3-6
words each) used together with objective to focus excerpts on the most
relevant content. Pass the queries from the prior web_search call that
surfaced these URLs, if applicable.
search_queries.title: Search Queries

session_id.description: Stable identifier for the current conversation. Generate a random value (UUID or 32+ character hex string) at the start of your session and reuse the exact same value on every web_search / web_fetch call. Do NOT change it between turns. Used for free-tier rate limiting and correlating your tool calls in our logs; ignored on paid-tier keys.

urls.description:
List of URLs to extract content from. Must be
valid HTTP/HTTPS URLs. Up to 20 URLs per request.
urls.title: Urls

content.description: Content returned for http client or server errors, if any.
content.title: Content

UsageItem.description: Usage item for a single operation.
UsageItem.title: UsageItem

V1ExtractResult.description: Extract result for a single URL.

excerpts.description: Relevant excerpted content from the URL, formatted as markdown.
excerpts.title: Excerpts

full_content.description: Full content from the URL formatted as markdown, if requested.
full_content.title: Full Content

publish_date.description: Publish date of the webpage in YYYY-MM-DD format, if available.
publish_date.title: Publish Date

title.description: Title of the webpage, if available.
title.title: Title

url.description: URL associated with the search result.
url.title: Url

V1ExtractResult.title: V1ExtractResult

type.description: Type of warning. Note that adding new warning types is considered a backward-compatible change.
type.title: Type

errors.description: Extract errors: requested URLs not in the results.
errors.title: Errors

session_id.description: Session identifier. Echoed back from the request if provided, otherwise generated by the server. Should be passed to future search and extract calls made by the agent as part of the same larger task.
session_id.title: Session Id

usage.description: Usage metrics for the extract request.
usage.title: Usage

warnings.description: Warnings for the extract request, if any.
warnings.title: Warnings
